title: Decoded blocks of a Boolean list
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $u$ be a finite list of Boolean symbols, and let $m$ be a natural number. For each integer $j$ from $0$ through $m-1$, take the $j$th block of $u$ and decode it into an optional machine-cell value; the ordered list of these decoded values is the list of decoded blocks.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
$u$ is a finite list of Boolean symbols
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the block extraction operation or the chunk decoder, so their precise conventions cannot be stated.
